objective: Gate 5D preflight R2 READ_ONLY: obtener esquema exacto y existencia de los objetos canonicos Communications antes de tocar codigo. Solo metadata SQL segura. No secretos. Sin DDL/DML. Production prohibida.

queries.name: gate5d_r2_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login

queries.name: gate5d_r2_exact_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.name IN ('Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue','Operativo_Notificaciones_Log') ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: gate5d_r2_exact_columns
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(c.object_id) AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE c.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.Operativo_Notificaciones_Log')) ORDER BY OBJECT_NAME(c.object_id),c.column_id

queries.name: gate5d_r2_keys_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) AS table_name,i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.Operativo_Notificaciones_Log')) AND i.index_id>0 ORDER BY table_name,index_name,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: gate5d_r2_row_counts
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,SUM(p.rows) AS total_rows FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0,1) WHERE t.name IN ('Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue','Operativo_Notificaciones_Log') GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: gate5d_r2_comm_connections_metadata
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_connections,SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(system_type,'')) LIKE '%TWILIO%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(system_type,'')) LIKE '%WHATS%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(system_type,'')) LIKE '%SMTP%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(system_type,'')) LIKE '%EMAIL%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(nombre,'')) LIKE '%TWILIO%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(nombre,'')) LIKE '%WHATS%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(nombre,'')) LIKE '%SMTP%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(nombre,'')) LIKE '%EMAIL%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS communication_candidates FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones

queries.name: gate5d_r2_rbac
queries.sql: SELECT codigo,nombre,modulo,activo FROM dbo.Sistema_RBAC_Permisos WHERE codigo LIKE '%NOTIFIC%' OR codigo LIKE '%COMUNIC%' OR codigo LIKE '%MENSAJ%' OR codigo LIKE '%TWILIO%' OR codigo LIKE '%WHATS%' ORDER BY codigo
